definitionBpmnXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:aarso="https://aarso.dev/bpmn" id="defs_localization-draft" targetNamespace="https://aarso.dev/loops">
  <bpmn:process id="localization-draft" name="Localization draft" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>e0</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="translate" name="Translate">
      <bpmn:extensionElements><aarso:meta role="translator" systemPrompt="You are a professional localization translator. Translate the field "${fieldKey}" into ${locale}, preserving any placeholders, tags, or formatting exactly as they appear in the source. Return only the translated text — no commentary, no surrounding quotes, no explanation.

Source text:
${sourceText}"/></bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>e0</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>e1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>e1</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="e0" sourceRef="start" targetRef="translate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="e1" sourceRef="translate" targetRef="end"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="diagram_localization-draft">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="plane_localization-draft" bpmnElement="localization-draft">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="shape_start" bpmnElement="start">
        <dc:Bounds x="0.0" y="0.0" width="130.0" height="64.0"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="shape_translate" bpmnElement="translate">
        <dc:Bounds x="160.0" y="0.0" width="130.0" height="64.0"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="shape_end" bpmnElement="end">
        <dc:Bounds x="320.0" y="0.0" width="130.0" height="64.0"/>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="edge_e0" bpmnElement="e0"/>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="edge_e1" bpmnElement="e1"/>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>

definition.name: Localization draft
definition.objective: Produce a translation draft for field "${fieldKey}" into ${locale}.

readme:
Localization draft (OSS template)

One params-driven step: given a source string, its field key, and a target locale, produces a first-pass translation draft for a human reviewer — it never writes anything back on its own. Ships in core as an open, forkable starting point (Studio P8's content-localization surface runs this template; anyone is free to fork or replace it with their own).

Params (filled in at run time, same `${key}` mechanism every loop uses):
- locale — the target locale, e.g. "es-MX" or "fr-FR"
- fieldKey — the string-table key or field name being localized
- sourceText — the source-locale text to translate

Output: the translated draft text (single step, no built-in critic pass — duplicate-and-extend this loop with a review node for stricter QA).
